name: h100
description: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 (GH100, Hopper, sm_90) at its 1980 MHz boost clock: one Vortex core per SM.

sources.NUM_CORES, NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE: 132 SMs (SXM5), 64 resident warps/SM, 4 schedulers x 32 lanes (NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU Architecture whitepaper)
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 50 MB L2 (whitepaper), rounded down to the power of two the cache accepts; 16 ways and 32 banks as in the a100 profile
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 5 HBM3 stacks x 16 64-bit channels at 5236 MT/s = 40 128-bit channel pairs, modelled as 32 at 6545 MT/s for a power-of-two interleave: 32 x 16 B x 6545 MT/s = 3.35 TB/s, the card's bandwidth; latency not calibrated
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEA: 1980 MHz boost clock, 3.35 TB/s (H100 SXM5 datasheet)
sources.FETCH_WIDTH: 4 SM processing blocks, each with its own warp scheduler, dispatch unit and L0 instruction cache (NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU Architecture whitepaper)
sources.CP_LLC_CLIENT: Host copies reach device memory through the L2 like every other client, so uploaded data is L2-resident at launch
